connect.title: Kokangisa telefone
connect.sub: Kotia code oyo na pr.social na Bisaleli. Telefone ekokangisama yango moko.
connect.path: Na pr.social: Bisaleli → Application ya kotala sites → kotia code.
connect.expired.sub: Code ezali kosala minutes zomi kaka. Zwa code mosusu.
connect.fail.network: Connexion na pr.social ezali te. Application ekomeka lisusu ntango internet ekozonga.
connect.fail.often: Ba code mingi esengami na reseau oyo. Meka lisusu na {min} minute.
connect.fail.busy: pr.social ezali na mosala mingi. Meka lisusu na minute moko.
connect.done.title: Ekangisami
connect.done: Telefone oyo ekangisami na compte ya @{user}.
connect.off.sub: Ekangolami na compte na yo na pr.social. Mpo na kokangisa yango lisusu, salela code ya sika oyo na nse.
connect.no.tasks: Telefone ekoki kokangisama sima ya misala {need} endimami. Sala misala na pr.social, sima kotia code oyo lisusu.
connect.no.devices: Compte na yo esili kokangisama na bilikya {max}. Kokangola moko na pr.social na Bisaleli, sima kotia code oyo lisusu.
connect.no.device: Telefone oyo ekoki te kokangisama. Télécharger application kaka na pr.social. Émulateurs mpe telefone na root ezali kosalisama te.
connect.no.restricted: Compte na yo ezali na etyelami ndelo. Telefone ekoki kokangisama ntango etyelami ndelo ekolongolama.
connect.no.off: Application ya kotala sites ezali te mpo na compte na yo sikoyo.
stats.title: Statistiques
limits.title: Limites
limits.hour.hint: Sites boni telefone oyo ekoki komonisa na ngonga moko
limits.day.hint: Sites boni compte mobimba ekoki komonisa na mokolo, na bilikya nyonso oyo ekangisami.
home.week.bars: Mbongo ezwami na telefone oyo na mikolo 7 oyo esili
home.ready: Sites bifungolama yango moko, moko na sima ya mosusu, wana application efungolami na ekrani. Ekrani etikali kofunga te, kasi ekomi kopola mwa moke.
home.need.wifi: Kokangisa na Wi-Fi to pesa internet ya telefone
home.need.internet: Internet ezali te: kokangisa Wi-Fi to internet ya telefone
home.need.charger: Kotia telefone na chargeur to pesa komonisa na batterie
home.need.battery: Kopela telefone: batterie ezali na moke koleka 20 %
home.need.cool: Telefone ezali moto mingi: sites bakobanda ntango ekopola
home.journal.hint: Site nyonso emonisami mpe soki etangami
home.update.hint: Ekoyika likolo ya oyo ezali sikoyo na minute moko. Compte na yo mpe mbongo ezwami ekobatela.
home.update.allow: Android esengi permission mpo na kotia ba application uta PR Surf. Pesa yango mpe zonga: installateur ekofungola yango moko.
home.update.failed.site: Mise à jour ekoki kotelechargama te. Komeka lisusu na minute mingi.
gate.blocked.sub: PR.SOCIAL abloki telefone oyo. Kokomela Lisungi mpo na koyeba likambo mpe nini esengeli kosala.
gate.restricted: Compte na yo ezali na etyelami ndelo
gate.restricted.sub: Ntango etyelami ndelo ezali, kotala ba site ezali kosalisama te. Lisungi ekoki koyebisa yango.
gate.update.sub: Version oyo esalaka lisusu te. Oyo ya sika ekoyika na minute moko, compte na yo mpe mbongo ezwami ekobatela.
gate.closed: Kotala ba site ezali te sikoyo
gate.closed.sub: Application ekotala yango moko, kozala na mosala te. Kotala ba site ekozonga, bouton ya kobanda ekozonga.
fix.vpn.sub: Ba commande mosusu basangisaka bato bakotala kaka soki VPN ezali te. Tika VPN mpo na kozwa sites mingi.
wait.empty.sub: Sites ya sika ebimaka ntango basombi basengi visites. Kotala lisusu na {time}. Tika application efungwama te.
wait.busy.sub: Komonisa ekokoba na {time}. Sites esili komonisama ekoki kobungisama te.
wait.off: Kotala ba site ezali te sikoyo
wait.network.sub: Eteni ya sika na {time}. Sites esili komonisama ekoki kobungisama te.
pause.screen.sub: Komonisa ekokoba ntango okozonga na application.
pause.no_wifi.sub: Sites bakomonisa kaka na Wi-Fi. Kokangisa na Wi-Fi to pesa internet ya telefone.
pause.no_charger.sub: Sites bakomonisa kaka ntango telefone ezali kocharger.
pause.low_battery.sub: Kotia chargeur, mpe komonisa ekokoba automatiquement.
pause.check_missed.sub: “Bozali wana?” eyanolamaki te na ntango. Pesa “Kokoba” mpo na kokoba lisusu.
check.title: Bozali wana?
check.sub: Pesa bouton ya nse mpo na kokoba. Kotalisa esili kotelema kino boyanola.
journal.title: Historique
journal.empty.title: Ezali na eloko te kino sikoyo
journal.empty: Ba site application ekotalisa ekoyela awa, mpe mosusu na mosusu ekolakisama soki etangami to te.
journal.none: Ezali na ba site te na liste oyo.
why.LOAD: Site efungwamaki te. Likama ezali na site, te na yo.
why.DNS: Adresse ya site esalaka lisusu te. Ezali na yo eloko moko te oyo esengeli kosala.
why.TIMEOUT: Ekoki kozala ete site ezali lent, to connexion ezali mpasi: Wi-Fi esalaka mingi malamu.
why.HTTP: Site eyanolaki na libunga. Ezali na yo eloko moko te oyo esengeli kosala.
why.SSL: Certificat ya sécurité ya site ezali na nguya te, yango wana application efungolaki yango te.
why.BLOCKED: Kobatela ya site epesaki application ndelo te ya kofungola page.
why.VIDEO: Video efungwamaki te: ekoki kolongolama to kobombama na prive.
why.CRASH: Navigateur ya application esalaki libunga na page oyo mpe efungwamaki lisusu.
why.EARLY: Application elakisaki site oyo liboso ya ntango ya kotalisama ekoki. Tala ete date mpe ntango na telefone ezali na automatique.
why.SHORT: Page ezalaki na ekrani ntango moke. Bobatela application efungwama mpe ekrani etumbola.
why.VIDEO_SHORT: Video etalamaki ntango moke: publicité to kotelema eyaki na ntango.
why.CONTROL: Oyo ezalaki page ya kotalela ya pr.social, mpe emonanaki malamu te.
why.NOT_SHOWN: Kotalisa esili liboso ya tango ya site oyo.
why.RESTRICTED: Compte na bino etyelami ndelo: ba site ekotangama te kino ndelo ekolongolama.
why.GONE: Application elakisaki site oyo na ntango ekoleka: efungamaki mwa ntango molai.
settings.title: Paramètres
settings.wifi.hint: Ba site mpe ba video bakosalela data ya mobile te
settings.charging.hint: Ekrani etumbolaka, yango wana batterie ekobatelama
settings.dim.hint: Mwa minuti nsima ya kopesa ekrani mosika, ekrani ekopetisama mpe kotalisa ekoyela
settings.support.hint: Mituna ya application to mbongo ezwami na bino
settings.account.hint: Telefone oyo ekangisami na compte oyo
settings.disconnect.ask: Telefone oyo ekokangama lisusu te na @{user}. Okoki kokangisa yango lisusu na code ya sika.
toast.busy: pr.social ezali na mosala mingi sikoyo. Komeka lisusu na mwa minuti.
toast.mobile: Data ya mobile ekoki. Okoki kobongola yango na Paramètres.
toast.nocharger: Ba site bakotalisama sikoyo mpe na batterie. Okoki kobongola yango na Paramètres.
toast.nobrowser: Navigateur ezuami te mpo na kofungola pr.social
toast.noupdate: Version ya sika ezali kosila te. Komeka lisusu nsima.
toast.still.restricted: Compte na bino ezali kaka etyelami ndelo.
toast.still.closed: Kotala ba site ezali te kino sikoyo.
settings.mini.hint: Ntango bokobima application, sites ekokoba kotala na lisanga ya moke likolo ya ba application mosusu
settings.mini.none: Telefone oyo ekoki te kosala lisanga ya moke
settings.mini.denied: Na bopamelo ya telefone, “Picture-in-picture” ezali kotikama mpo na PR Surf
home.mini: Okoki kosalela ba application mosusu na ntango yango: sites ekokoba kotala na lisanga ya moke.
show.resumed: Kotala ekobaki lisusu na esika esilaki kotika
notify.stopped.sub: Pesa ntoki mpo na kokoba: sites ekokoba kotala na esika esili kotika.
skip.title: Kolongola site oyo?
skip.sub: Ekotangama te, mpe ekomonisama bino lisusu te.
skip.why: Likambo nini ezali mabe? (na eposi na bino)
skip.r.adult: Mpo na bato minene to ekobangisa
skip.done: Ekokiyami. Site ya sima ezali kofungwama.
